maxReconciliationAttempts.description:
Number of attempts allowed to reconcile from the last stored K8s Resource Version for a given K8s Resource.
This reconciliation can fail when our stored K8s Resource Version is too old for the K8sApiServer.
Subsequently, we are bound to receive a HTTP 410 GONE Response which will look like the following:
{
    "type": "ERROR",
    "object": {
        "status": "Failure",
        "message": "too old resource version: 22063149 (223332634)",
        "reason": "Expired",
        "code": 410
    }
}

To minimize loss of data, we attempt to reconcile the watch using the suggested (resourceVersion).
However, there's no guarantee that this resourceVersion will not result in a HTTP GONE 410.
Hence, the need of having a limit on the number of attempts before which we send "0" as the resourceVersion, which is
guaranteed to get a 200 response from K8sApiServer. To understand the semantics of how resourceVersions work with
a WATCH call see: https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/using-api/api-concepts/#semantics-for-watch
